subject: Recap: Security & Private/VPC options - next steps and VSQ initiation
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: Security & Private/VPC options - next steps and VSQ initiation

Hi Alex - thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Security posture summary (what we covered)
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report in progress for 2026; summary attached. Formal report will be available after the final audit in Q1.
- Data residency & GDPR: We support regionally isolated deployments (EU/US) and can provide DPA/standard contractual clauses on request.
- HIPAA: We support HIPAA-eligible configurations; will need BAAs for prod data flows.

2) Private deployment options you asked about
- VPC Private: Customer-managed VPC peering or PrivateLink; dedicated subnets for inference nodes, no public ingress.
- On-prem / air-gapped: We offer an on-prem bundle that can be deployed into an air-gapped network; it includes deployment artifacts and an ops checklist.
- Network isolation: We enforce egress controls, strict IAM for service accounts, and optional host-level hardening.

3) Vendor Security Questionnaire (VSQ)
- I started the VSQ for Acme and attached our SOC 2 summary and a high-level VPC diagram. Can you attach your VSQ answers (if you have a copy) or let us know when your security team will start?

Attachments: redwood-soc2-2026-summary.pdf, redwood-vpc-architecture.png

Proposed next steps:
- Alex / Acme: Share your VSQ answers or a point of contact for your security team (target: this week).
- Redwood: Marissa and Rishi will own the VSQ responses and provide a detailed deployment diagram & runbook (ETA 3 business days).
- If Acme needs an air-gapped on-prem evaluation, we'll schedule a separate technical workshop.

If that looks right I'll open a HubSpot task and loop in our security architect (Lauren) to draft the deployment diagram.

- Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0123

- Audit logs & PII handling: default behavior and opt-out controls for prompt retention.
- On-prem installer dependencies: outbound endpoints, ports, and recommended offline install steps for air-gapped envs.
- Deployment diagram: include VPC peering vs PrivateLink options, subnet breakdown (control plane, inference nodes, management), and KMS/HSM integration notes.

I attached our SOC 2 summary and the high-level VPC architecture diagram for context. Please coordinate directly with Priya for any technical clarifications. 

Marissa / Rishi - ETA for completed VSQ responses + deployment diagram?

Thanks,
Marcus
